notes.title: UPADTE #11- GOODBYE, MY FRIENDS
notes.notes:
This new update introduces a new mechanic and the energy points assigned to minimonsters at higher levels have been revised.

Also 6 new minimonsters have been added.

Here is the full changelog v1.5:

NEW MECHANICS
- Now when a land is passed, players must say goodbye to one of their minimosters (if they have 4 minimonsters). This may seem a bit harsh, but it is actually a mechanism to encourage the player to keep capturing new minimonsters in the next land, which, in case you don't know, have a higher level than the ones captured in the previous land.

IMPROVEMENTS
- When starting a new game, it is now guaranteed that the two initial minimonsters with which the player starts will be different (not the same).
- The potions menu can now be accessed from the pre-combat screen.
- Added the possibility to view the stats of the minimonsters that are going to fight, from the battlefield selection screen, by clicking on them.
- Information has been added to the buttons on the battlefield selection screen.
- Added information about the buttons in the opponent selection screen.
- Added the possibility to exit the instructions by pressing the ESC key.

ADDED
- Added new Minimonster: Void Turtle
- Added new Minimonster: Blue Frog
- Added new Minimonster: Armored Walker
- Added new Minimonster: Gray Wolf
- Added new Minimonster: Chubby Bunny
- Added new Minimonster: Gargoyle

CHANGES
- Revised and changed the amount of energy that minimonsters increase each time a land is passed.
- Wturtle can no longer be a starting minimonster. Its place is now taken by Plantrap.
- The number of coins required to pass the 'Troll Bridge' quest has been reduced from 6 to 4 (6 -> 4).
- Changed the delete saved file icon to a skull.
- Sand Scorpion minimonster image changed.

FIXES
- Corrected some adventure texts.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41106132/7cec5e39f6625c0f3f02cc3298f36fec7f80ce4c.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE #10 - SPIKED MINIMONSTERS
notes.notes:
This new update includes a new game mechanic: Minimonsters with a new skill 'Spiked'.

Also included are 4 new minimonsters and 4 new top-level quests.

Here is the full changelog v1.4:

ADDED
- Added 4 new minimonsters with the 'Spiked' skill. (3 bronze and 1 gold)
- Added 4 new adventures (Level 3).
- Added skill icons for minimonsters in the battlefield selection panel.

CHANGES
- Changed the word 'Rainbow' in the element of some minimonsters to 'Rainb' to avoid the minimonster'ss characteristics boxes getting out of sync.
- Spiked Crab now has the special skill 'Spiked'. 
- The explanatory message of the 'poison' skill has been modified and improved.
- The description of the skill 'Stoicism' is now better explained.
- The description of the skill 'Stun' is now better explained.

BUGSFIXES
- Fixed the size of an image of the MiniMonster 'Angry Turtle'.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41106132/fa23a5b37a0b896fa7498f55c2c47fb54f621c78.png[/img]

THANK YOU FOR PLAYING!

notes.title: UPDATE #5 - FASTER COMBATS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/cbffbc30436080fc36d41d898400ad9b68a5cc02.png[/img]

Some players felt that being able to nullify attacks, and having 0 damage was no fun at all and could even make combat tedious. And I think they were quite right.

From now on all attacks made, and even defenses, will cause a minimum damage of 1. Also the poison damage has been increased to 2.

This update is important because it can change a lot the combat strategy. 

I hope you like it.

Changelog v1.2:
- Minimum damage caused by each attack or defense will always be 1.
- Poison increases the damage caused from 1 to 2. 

THANK YOU FOR PLAYING WOM.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/3c97491b44810aad60e558361f72e7400ce65233.png[/img]

notes.title: #3 - BIG, BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/e0699aa775c239c51696e2f63a9f250d33016642.png[/img]

After receiving very good feedback, I decided a few weeks ago to make a big update. And here it is. This practically changes the way you play WOM.

I would like to give special thanks to Birbarian (developer of AvianSong) and Almarod. Your ideas were very helpful. Thank you.

CHANGELOG - VERSION 1.1 -

ADDED
- 11 new MiniMonsters (60 total).
- 9 new MiniBosses.
- 8 new Adventures (35 total).
- The MiniMonster chosen for the fight will no longer be available for the next one, so the player must choose another one.
- New generation system for MiniMonsters. Now, gold or silver MiniMonsters are harder to find.
- New options to change Minimonster or Exit in Choosing Battleground screen.
- New Information button in battlegrounds screen.

IMPROVEMENTS
- Balanced game difficulty.
- A lot of graphic of MiniMonsters have been upgraded.
- Captured Minimonsters now have an higher level depending on the number of lands cleared.
- Now, all the gold combats in a land will be against mini-bosses.
- Battlegrounds will not be the same when they are generated.

CHANGES
-The minimum number of MiniMonsters in your party is 2 now.

BUGFIXES
- Fixed the size of a lot of MiniMonsters.
- Fixed an issue where you clicked on a MiniMonster in combat and the combat was finished.
- Fixed an issue where you could choose an empty space as MiniMonster for the combat.
- Fixed a visual bug when you change your enemy and appeared a silver or gold star Minimon.
- Some typos fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/3c97491b44810aad60e558361f72e7400ce65233.png[/img]

notes.title: World of MiniMonsters has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/ff692a6db6b089e48cfb25698eab3964a1ec3274.png[/img]

WORLD OF MINIMONSTERS HAS BEEN RELEASED!

You can enjoy the 10% discount per launch.  

World of MiniMonsters was a game that I always want to make. I found an opportunity and I was working on it several weeks and I'm glad with the result.

However the last days, testing the game I have had a lot of ideas to improve the game. Many people helps me with their suggestions and ideas and they have added a lot of beautiful stuff to 'my todo list'. So this game will have new features soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/4b7460e5de22b60d99a29dfed57e4e69667386ee.png[/img]

And WHAT IS THE NEXT?

Well, there are many interesting ideas contributed by the testers and kindly people but I think these will be the next steps (and it doesn't have to be in this order):

- The captured MiniMonster will be more powerfull if the game is more advanced.
- The possibility to change an own MiniMonsters in the middle of the combat.
- A new type of adventure: The errant merchant.
-Fatigue. You should change the minimonster and choose any one new each new combat.
- More adventures.
- And more Minimonsters! (There are some more thought). 

HAVE YOU ANY IDEAS OR SUGGESTIONS?

You can leave your suggestions, wishes and bug reports on the World of MiniMonsters forums here, in Steam. You also can write me in my new Discord channel: [url=]https://discord.gg/FhCPHue2.[/url]

Today I’m releasing another game too: World of Paranoia. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1720740/WORLD_OF_PARANOIA/ 

Take a peek if you want. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/a064bb28e6d71060f875ff46d50c3fdad9e03f9a.png[/img]

Have you choosen your favorite MiniMonster?.

Thank you for buy World of MiniMonsters.
